Lemma
[Main factorial curvature estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0248, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0249, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0250 1. ch13:13.29\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

There is $C_n<\infty $ such that, if $K=\sup _{\mathcal M}|\Rm |(\cdot ,0)$, then for every $m$, \[ \sum _{k=0}^m rac{t^k}{((k+1)!)^2}| abla ^k\Rm |^2(x,t) \leq rac{K^2}{(1- frac 12C_nKt)^2} \] on $0\leq t\leq (4C_nK)^{-1}$. In particular, $| abla ^k\Rm |(x,t)\leq rac87(k+1)!Kt^{-k/2}$.
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:chow-ii-curvature-derivative-evolution-inequality ↗ thm:noncompact-scalar-pde-ode-comparison Set $A_k=t^{k/2}| abla ^k\Rm |/(k+1)!$, $B_k=t^{(k-1)/2}| abla ^k\Rm |/k!$, $\Phi =\sum _{k=0}^mA_k^2$, and $\Psi =\sum _{k=1}^mB_k^2$. Weighted summation, Cauchy–Schwarz, and $\sum _{i\geq 0}(i+2)^{-2}\leq 1$ give

\[ (\partial _t-\Delta )\Phi \leq -(1-2C_nt\Phi ^{1/2})\Psi +C_n\Phi ^{3/2}. \]

For $t\leq (4C_nK)^{-1}$, comparison with $y'=C_ny^{3/2}$, $y(0)=K^2$, and continuity yield the stated bound. Taking its $k$-th summand gives the derivative estimate.
